art_direction: 浅藕粉底，双眼间距舒展，瞳孔稳稳居中，沉着可靠。
composition_variation: Space the eyes farther apart and nearly level, right lower contour fuller. Use low relaxed lids with clear colored openings and large centered pupils. Extend the outer corners in short natural curved tapers. Balanced spacing conveys reliable composure and readiness rather than a threatening stare. Preserve exactly TWO eyes with the SAME iris hue, large black pupils and one slim elongated ivory glint each. Emotion comes only from the eye geometry and gaze. Use matte gouache, organic curved tapered boundaries and a visibly pale colored ground; no eyebrows, mouth, head, sclera or other marks.
visible_subject: two eye graphics only; no eyebrows, mouth or head
style_inspiration: Latest user chat image observed locally: a mildly disdainful asymmetric gaze in opaque hand-painted black and cyan eye shapes. Only a written description was transmitted. No chat attachment was uploaded or used as binary input. Earlier eyes-only constraint retained.
visual_review: passed: inspected compressed contact sheet for readable eye expression, coordinated same-color irises, matte curved brush shapes, comfortable pastel background, no added face features, text or watermark
